class.name: GDExtensionAPIDump
class.brief_description: Generates and validates extension API descriptions.
class.description: Editor-build utility for generating API metadata used by GDExtension bindings. It can include project-specific global and autoload classes when a project is loaded.

method.name: dump_extension_api
method.description: Returns the generated extension API as a JSON string.

method.name: generate_extension_api
method.description: Returns extension API metadata. Includes class reference documentation when [param include_docs] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: generate_extension_json_file
method.description: Writes extension API metadata to [param path]. Includes class reference documentation when [param include_docs] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: validate_extension_json_file
method.description: Validates the extension API JSON at [param path] against the current engine API and returns an [enum Error] result.
